final: WITH event_name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), above_average AS (SELECT event_name, average_amount FROM event_name_averages WHERE average_amount > (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM event_name_averages WHERE average_amount IS NOT NULL)) SELECT event_name, average_amount, average_amount - (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM event_name_averages WHERE average_amount IS NOT NULL) AS difference_from_overall_average, average_amount / (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM above_average) AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM above_average
